summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 27, 2026, announcing the filing of its Reference Form (annual report) for the year ended December 31, 2025 with the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM). The filing is a routine disclosure of annual information, not a special situation. The document provides no details on any transaction, corporate action, or event that would trigger a special-situations classification. This is a standard regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer.
